3. Question: Does Section 2(b)(2)(C) apply to Bob in 2014?

My analysis:
- Bob's spouse (Alice) died during 2014 (July 9th)
- Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies when a taxpayer's spouse died during the taxable year
- Therefore Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014

The claim "Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014" is TRUE.
